inspection: Direct source inspection plus actual checkpoint/load-trace audits; CPU only, no training or new selection

files.finding: SOURCE constructs Network from initialization; fits input/target/depth statistics only on outer training wells; CUDA label tables contain only training rows; both expert and router parameters train.
FeatureBuilder fits 64 training wells; feature medians/scales derive from training inputs; synthetic whitelist excludes DEVI/AZIM/BIT/CASE and derivatives.
FeatureBuilder uses declared input columns and per-well curve transforms, not output labels.
Shared cache has no learned weights or shared Q; 63 amplitude view statistics use training wells/rows; each model descriptor restores private source Q.
Canonical grouped population and disjoint 64/16 wells; Q trace restricted to training raw rows and observation strictly before own source best; reference input bank averages training wells only.
Historical checkpoint paths redirect to own fold/seed parents; guarded actual loads forbid other seed/historical learned checkpoints; stage chain is SOURCE plus seven explicit stages.

Loss receives only labeled training windows and own channel; forward receives input curves/depth/well inputs; fresh late branch optimizers include raw-feature backbone parameters; max80/pat10->14 preserved.
POR conditional RPS/CE uses only supplied masked POR training labels, alongside learned residual representation.
SW state prior uses train_raw; categorical auxiliary targets use masked SW training labels; additional encoder/readout jointly train.
Action utility constructor uses fixed action/edge tables and train-fit metadata; forward receives masked training labels, not evaluator validation truth.
Native prediction forward uses no labels; computes both joint distributions and fixed candidate weights uniformly for every row. Truth is not used in model forward or grid construction.
Fixed weights are read from predeclared plan, never reselected on folds1-4. Per-fold argmax ratios are saved in a separately labeled diagnostic. OOF scores use all723556 rows, not mean fold scores.

selection_boundary: The pair and fixed ratios were selected on fold5. Fold5 is screening/tuning data, not untouched validation. Foldwise optimal OOF additionally tunes each fold and is diagnostic only.
stage_boundary: Each selected model has8 actual stages. User-authorized two-model ensemble has16 historical stages; no claim of8 total ensemble stages.
speed_boundary: Batch elapsed wall includes four folds for both models, CPU work, overlap/serial operation and approval waiting; it is not one-model training time or a controlled concurrency speed benchmark.
